classification.difficultyReason: Infer both picture dimensions from centred frames, then expand their product.

content.prompt: Find an expanded expression for the area of the pictures centred in these frames.

spec.description: Centred inner square labelled Picture, inside an outer square. Outer top and right sides have double equality ticks; every inner side has one equality tick. A horizontal double-headed arrow measures the right-hand frame gap.
spec.mathematics: Outer side x cm; uniform frame width 3 cm; picture side x−6 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions and labels are visible; no derived picture dimensions or area are printed.

answer.worked:
The picture has side length $(x-6)\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(x-6)(x-6)\\&=x^2-6x-6x+36\\&=(x^2-12x+36)\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Centred landscape picture inside an outer landscape rectangle. Separate horizontal left-gap and vertical bottom-gap double-headed arrows are both labelled 5 cm.
spec.mathematics: Outer dimensions x cm and (x+30) cm; picture dimensions (x−10) cm and (x+20) cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied outer dimensions, frame widths and Picture label are visible.

answer.worked:
The picture has dimensions $(x-10)\text{ cm}$ and $(x+30-10)=(x+20)\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=(x-10)(x+20)\\&=x^2+20x-10x-200\\&=(x^2+10x-200)\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
